articles.title: US sanctions Xinbi scam marketplace, restrains $52M in crypto
articles.snippet: The Justice Department seized Xinbi’s Telegram channels and two wallets as investigators pursued 47 additional wallets across its alleged laundering network.

articles.title: Mexico Seizes 300 Crypto Mining Rigs Wired Into a Hydroelectric Dam
articles.snippet: Forensic accountants are tracing who paid for the mining hardware, and money laundering has not been ruled out.
